title: Dual-layer spectral detector computed tomography multiparameter machine learning model for prediction of lymph node metastases in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
summary: A multiparametric dual-layer spectral CT machine-learning model predicts lymph-node metastasis in esophageal squamous-cell carcinoma, with training- and test-cohort AUCs reported. Published in Cancer Imaging.
